messages:
Make applyPatch validation and edge cases conform to RFC 6902

- Reject holes in sparse patch arrays, values and documents (map() skipped them).
- Require operations to be plain objects and read only their own members.
- Reject cyclic values/documents with InvalidPatchError/TypeError instead of a stack overflow.
- Report a move into its own child as InvalidPatchError during up-front validation.
- Make move with from == path a no-op, including for the root.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
